SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
5054-60 North Ashland Avenue
From RS-3 to B2-3

#22845-TI

The Property
The subject property is comprised of three lots containing a vacant asphalt lot, a 2.5 story single family home, and

avacant 1.5 story single family home with a garage. The surrounding area is comprised of varying zoning districts,
including RS-3, RT-4, RM-4.5, B1-3, B3-2, C1-2, and various Planned Developments. The area is improved with
buildings of various heights ranging from 1 to 6 stories that contain single and multi-residential use, commercial
uses and institutional uses. The property is also a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented Provisions of
the Chicago Zoning Ordinance (Section 17-10-0102-B (1)), as it is within 2,174 feet of the Metra Ravenswood
Union Pacific North Station entrance. It is also within 701 feet of the Foster Avenue Bus Line Corridor Roadway
Segment.

The Project
The Applicant proposes to demolish the existing improvements and construct a five-story, 26-unit residential

building, 17 automobile parking spaces, and 26 bicycle parking spaces. No commercial space is proposed. The
zoning height of the building will be 53.33 feet. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a zoning
change for the subject property from a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District to a B2-3
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning application and seeks all relief
necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the proposed project, including: 1) a variation under 17-
13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-EE to increase the number of automobile parking spaces from the required 13 spaces
to 17 spaces; 2) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the front setback to 0 feet; 3) a variation under
section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the rear yard setback from 30 feet to 21.98 feet; 4) a variation under section 17-
13-1101-B to reduce the north side setback to 0 feet, and the south side setback from 7.12 feet to 5 feet, for a total
combined side yard setback of 5 feet; 5) a variation under 17-13-1101-D to reduce the number of loading spaces
from 1 to 0; and 6) a variation under 17-13-1101-B to reduce the front and side property line setbacks for stairway
enclosures on corner lots per section 17-17-0311-C(3).

17-3-0308 Specific Criteria for Transit Served Locations Requirements
1. The project compties with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B:

RESPONSE: The project complies with Section 17-10-0102-B as the property is a Transit Served
Location within 2,174 feet of the Metra Ravenswood Union Pacific North Station entrance. A variation
will be requested to allow 4 more additional spaces to the otherwise required parking.

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-3-0504, except paragraph H if the
project is not located along a pedestrian street and except paragraph C if the land use is designated in a non-
commercial use group, pertaining to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets, even if the project is not
located along a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street:

RESPONSE: The project complies with Section 17-3-0504 because:

© Building Location: The front fagades of the building face W. Carmen Ave. and N. Ashland Ave., the
design complies with sections (1) and (2)(a)-(c), as the building’s front and side setbacks are no more
than 5 feet, and the entrance size is within the required parameters;

e° Doors and Entrances: The building’s entrances will face W. Carmen Ave. and N. Ashland Ave., which
are not a pedestrian street, but serves as the front of the building;

° Off-Street Parking: 17 on-site automobile parking spaces will be provided;

° Parking Location: On-site parking will be to the rear or enclosed; and

e Driveways/Vehicle Access: The Applicant will provide access to parking areas from the alley.

3. The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development Guide: Station Area
Typology, and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines adopted by the Chicago Plan
Commission:

RESPONSE: The property is identified under the City of Chicago Metra Station Area Typology Study as

Fine

4. Residential building projects shall not have a number of parking spaces in excess of 50% of the Minimum
Automobile Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in Section 17-10-0207 with any fractional result
rounded up to the next higher whole number, unless additional parking spaces are approved as
an administrative adjustment under the provisions of Section 17-13-1003-EE; and

RESPONSE: The Applicant seeks to increase by 4 spaces the number of required parking from 13 to 17
spaces under the provisions of 17-13-1003-EE.

5. The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago Department
of Transportation.
RESPONSE: The project will comply with applicable Travel Demand Study and Management Plan
tules promulgated by the Chicago Department of Transportation.

Bicycle Parking: 26
